services.title: SEO and organic growth
services.body: Nearly two decades of it. Technical audits, content strategy, local SEO and bespoke engagements for clients who care about compounding traffic rather than tricks that expire. Currently in-house at a European digital marketing agency, working remotely on client SEO.

services.title: Comparative religion
services.body: Co-founder and executive editor of **Bismika Allahuma: Muslim Responses To Anti-Islam Polemics**, plus a network of sister sites and a YouTube channel. Debates and dialogues with Christians, Jews, atheists and the occasional Hindu or Buddhist.

services.title: Writing, editing and publishing
services.body: Poetry and prose in Bahasa Melayu and English since 1995, five books to date, and, since 2025, **Langgam Fikir Enterprise**, an imprint in Seri Kembangan, Selangor that publishes my own titles in literature, history and religious discourse.

services.title: Tools for the open web
services.body: WordPress plugins and web utilities that solve unglamorous problems well: clean citations, structured data, readable long-form posts, typography that behaves. All of it public on GitHub.

books.title: Dua Dasawarsa: Sebuah Kumpulan Puisi 2005–2025
books.note: Two decades of poems, gathered: the ideas and events that shaped the thinking.

books.title: Paulus: Perosak Risalah al-Masīḥ
books.note: On Paul of Tarsus and the effects of his teachings. An English companion volume, *The Apostle of Doom*, is being developed in tandem.

books.title: Buddhism: A Muslim Primer
books.note: An introduction for Muslim readers · Jahabersa.

repos.name: citepress
repos.body: Academic citation plugin for WordPress with BibTeX, RIS, EndNote, CSL-JSON, CFF and Dublin Core export, plus JSON-LD structured data and analytics.

repos.name: abstract-box
repos.body: Adds a modernist “Abstract Box” section to posts via shortcode, with schema.org JSON-LD and a Gutenberg block.

repos.name: book-wp
repos.body: A modernised build of the Book-WP theme, refreshed to present standards and expanded, with a legacy branch kept alive for older sites.

repos.name: auto-justify-content
repos.body: Justifies text across posts, pages and Elementor content, with optional hyphenation and responsive controls.

repos.name: citation-helper
repos.body: An APA citation helper website, deliberately ad-free.

repos.name: book-wp-legacy
repos.body: The original Book-WP theme, patched for current WordPress versions. No new features, just survival.
